m: लल् (cf. √ लड्) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. ix, 77) ललति (mc. also ˚ते), to play, sport, dally, frolic, behave loosely or freely, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to loll or wag the tongue (see below) : Caus. लालयति, ˚ते (Pass. लाल्यते), to cause to sport or dally, caress, fondle, foster, cherish, ib.; to wave, flourish, Hariv.; to favour, Sāh.; (Ā.) to desire, Dhātup. (cf. under √ लड्).
a: लल् — {vI.v} {c1c} U. (ललति-ते) To play, move about, sport, dally, frolic; पनसफलानीव वानरा ललंति Mk. 8. 8; गजकलभा इव बधुला ललामः 4. 28; ललदजगरघरेकोटराणां Māl. 5. 15. {vII.v} {c10c} U. or Caus. (लालयति-ते, लालित) 1 To cause to sport or play, caress, fondle, coax, dandle; लालने बहवो दोषास्ताडने बहवो गुणाः . तस्मात्पुत्रं च शिष्यं च ताडयेन्न तु लालयेत् .. Subhāṣ.; Ku. 5. 15. --2 To desire. {vIII.v} {c10c} U. (ललयति-ते) 1 To fondle; Mk. 4. 28. --2 To loll the tongue. --3 To desire.

a line, row

a: ललाम — a. (मी f.) 1 Beautiful, lovely, charming. --2 Having a mark on the forehead marked with a blaze. --मं 1 An ornament for the forehead, an ornament or decoration in general; (m. also in this sense); अहं तु तामाश्रमललामभूतां शकुंतलामधिकृत्य ब्रवीमि Ś. 2; Śi. 4. 28. --2 Anything the best of its kind. --3 A mark on the forehead. --4 A sign, symbol, mark in general. --5 A banner, flag. --6 A row, series, line. --7 A tail. --8 A mane. --9 Eminence, dignity, beauty. --10 A horn. --मः A horse.

chief or principal

m: ललाट n. (later form of रराट, q.v.) the forehead, brow, AV. &c. &c. (˚टे ind. on the forehead, in front; the destiny of every individual is believed by the Hindūs to be written by Brahmā on his forehead on the 6th day after birth See RTL. 370)
a: ललाटं — [लड्-अच् डस्य लः, ललमटति अट्-अण् वा Tv.] The forehead; लिखितमपि ललाटे प्रोज्झितुं कः समर्थः H. 1. 21; N. 1. 15. --Comp. --अक्षः an epithet of Śiva. --तटं the slope of the forehead, the forehead itself. --पट्टः, --पट्टिका {1} the flat surface of the forehead. {2} a tiara, fillet. --रेखा {1} a line on the forehead. {2} a wrinkled brow. {3} a coloured sectarial mark on the forehead. --लेखा the line on the forehead.

k.v: स्याद्दाम्भिकः कौक्कुटिको यश्चादूरेरितेक्षणः। ललाटिकः प्रभोर्भालदर्शी कार्याक्षमश्च यः॥ भूभृन्नितम्बवलयचक्रेषु कटकोऽस्त्रियाम्. सूच्यग्रे क्षुद्रशत्रौ च रोमहर्षे च कण्टकः। पाकौ पक्तिशिशू मध्यरत्ने नेतरि नायकः। पर्यङ्कः स्यात्परिकरे स्याद्व्याघ्रेऽपि च लुब्धकः। पेटकस्त्रिषु वृन्देऽपि गुरौ देश्ये च देशिकः। खेटकौ ग्रामफलकौ धीवरेऽपिच जालिकः। पुष्परेणौ च किञ्जल्कः शुल्कोऽस्त्री स्त्रीधनेऽपि च। स्यात्कल्लोलेऽप्युत्कलिका वार्धकं भाववृन्दयोः। करिण्यां चापि गणिका दारकौ बालभेदकौ। अन्धेऽप्यनेडमूकः स्याट्टङ्कौ दर्पाश्मदारणौ। मृद्भाण्डेऽप्युष्ट्रिका मन्थे खजको रसदर्वके॥

s: strI, (lalita + wAp .) kastUrI । dArI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ nadIviSezaH । yaTA, -- “niminAmnastu rAjarzeH SApAdbrahmasutaH purA । vaSizwo hyaSarIro'BUt SApAcca niminastaTA ॥ tato brahmopadeSena nirjane kAmarUpake । sanDyAcale tapastepe tasya vizRuraBUttadA ॥ pratyakzastasya devasya varadAnAnmahAmuniH । amftAnyavatAryyASu kuRqaM kftvA girestawe । tatra snAtvA ca pItvA ca SarIraM prApa pUritam ॥ tasmAdamftakuRqAttu sanDyA nAma nadI varA । niHsftA tatra cAplutya cirAyuragado Bavet ॥ tasmAt pUrvvantu kuRqAttu lalitAKyA saridvarA । sAgarAddakziRAt pUrvvaM mahAdevAvatAritA ॥ vESAKaSuklapakzasya tftIyAyAM narastu yaH । kuryyAdvE lalitAsnAnaM sa SamBusadanaM vrajet ॥ lalitAyAH pUrvvatIre BagavAnnAma parvvataH । svayaM vizRurliNgarUpI tatrAste BagavAn hariH ॥ lalitAyAM naraH snAtvA dvAdaSyAM Suklapakzake । BagavantaM samAruhya yo yajet parameSvaram । sa yAti vizRuBavanaM SarIreRa virAjatA ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 81 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ gopIviSezaH । yaTA, -- “aKilarasAmftamUrttiH prasfmararucirudDatArakA pAliH । kalitaSyAmA lalito rADApreyAn viDurjayati ॥ iti BaktirasAmftasinDuH ॥ lalitA SyAmalA SEvyA padmA BadrASca SrUyante ॥ iti tawwIkAyAM jIvagosvAmI ॥ tasyAH svarUpaM yaTA, -- “yA durgA sEva lalitA lalitA sEva rADikA । etAsAmantaraM nAsti satyaM satyaM hi nArada ! ॥” iti pAdme pAtAlaKaRqe rAsalIlAyAM nAradaM prati SrIkfzRavAkyam ॥ rAgiRIviSezaH । sA ca meGarAgasya patnI । yaTA, saNgItadAmodare । “lalitA mAlasI gOqI nAwI devakirI taTA । meGarAgasya rAgiRyo BavantImAH sumaDyamAH ॥” (sA tu hanUmanmate hindolarAgasya patnI । someSvaramate vasantasya patnI । yaTA, saMgItadarpaRe । “velAvalI rAmakirI deSAKyA pawamaYjarI । lalitA sahitA etA hindolasya varANganAH ॥” “deSI devakirI cEva varAwI toqikA taTA । lalitA cATa hindolI vasantasya varANganAH ॥” asyA DyAnAdikamAha tatrEva । aTa lalitA । ri-pa-varjyA ca lalitA OqavA satrayA matA । mUrcCanA SudDamaDyA syAt sampUrRAM kecidUcire । DEvatatrayasaMyuktA dvitIyA lalitA matA ॥” DyAnam । yaTA, -- “praPullasaptacCadamAlyakaRWA sugOrakAntiryuvatI sudfzwiH । viniSvasantI sahasA praBAte vilAsaveSA lalitA pradizwA ॥” udAharaRam । sa ga ma Da ni sa । aTavA, -- sa ri ga ma pa Da ni sa । iti praTamA ॥ Da ni sa ga ma Da । iti dvitIyA ॥ iti lalitA ॥)

s: strI, (lalitAKyA saptamI .) BAdraSuklasaptamI । tatra kukkuwIvrataM kAryyam । yaTA Bavizye । “BAdre mAsi site pakze saptamyAM niyamena yA । snAtvA SivaM lesvayitvA maRqale ca sahAmbikam । pUjayecca tadA tasyAM duzprApaM nEva vidyate ॥” iti kukkuwIvratatvena KyAtam । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ tadviDiryaTA । tatrAdO svastivAcanapUrvvakaM saNkalpaM kuryyAt । o~ adyetyAdi BAdre mAsi Sukle pakze saptamyAntiTO yAvajjIvanaparyyantaM amukagotrA SrImadamukI SivadurgAprItikAmA prativarzIyaBAdraSuklasaptamyAM gaReSAdidevatApUjApUrvvakaSivapArvvatIpUjAyAvajjIvanaqorakaDAraRaBavizyapurARoktavratakaTASravaRarUpalalitAsaptamIvratamahaM karizye । tataH saNkalpasUktaM paWitvA sAmAnyArGyaM viDAya gaReSAdIn saMpUjya BUtaSudDyAdikaM viDAya maRqalAdizu pUjAmAraBeta । tato DyAtvA svaSirasi puzpaM dattvA mAnasopacArEH saMpUjya arGyaM saMsTApya punarDyAtvA AvAhayet । SivapUjAviDinA SivaM durgApUjAviDinA durgAYca yaTASaktyupacArEH saMpUjya AvaraRadevAn pUjayet । tato 'zwagranTiyuktaqorakaM dugDena siktaM SivadurgAByAM arpayitvA tat qorakaM vAmakare badDvA Bojyamutsfjya kaTAM SfRuyAt । azwaPalAni dadyAt । tato dakziRAM dadyAt ॥ * ॥ aTa kaTA । SrIkfzRa uvAca । “lomaSo nAMma devarzirmaTurAmAgataH purA । so'rccito vasudevena devakyA ca yuDizWira ! ॥ upavizwaH kaTAH puRyAH kaTayAmAsa vE tadA । tataH kaTayituM BUyaH kaTAmetAM pracakrame ॥ kaMsena nihatAH puttrA jAtA jAtAH punaH punaH । mftavatsA devaki ! tvaM puttraduHKena duHKitA ॥ yaTA candramuKI dInA baBUva nahuzapriyA । taTA tvaM devakI Badre puttraduHKena duHKitA ॥ paScAccIrRavratA sA tu baBUvAkzayaputtrikA । tvameva devakI devi ! Bavizyasi na saMSayaH ॥ devakyuvAca । kA sA candramuKI dInA baBUva nahuzapriyA । kaTaM cIrRavrataM samyak tasyAH santatikAraRam ॥ lomaSa uvAca । ayoDyAyAM purA rAjA nahuzo nAma viSrutaH । tasya rAjYo mahAdevI nAmnA candramuKI priyA ॥ purohitasya tasyEva patnI mAlA ca nAmikA । tayorAsIddfQaprItiH spfhaRIyA parasparam ॥ aTa te'pi ca mitriRyO snAnArTaM sarayUjale । prApte prAptAstu tatrEva bahuSo nagarANganAH ॥ snAtAstA maRqalaM cakrustanmaDye vyaktarUpiRam । leKayitvA SivaM SAntamumayA saha SaNkaram ॥ ganDapuzpAkzatErBaktyA pUjayitvA yaTAviDi । praRanya SirasA BaktyA dfzwAstAByAM varastriyaH ॥ kimidaM kriyate sADvyaH kaTyatAM yadi rocate । kadA vA kriyate kiM vA PalaM samyak taducyatAm ॥ striya UcuH । pUjito'smABiretaltin pArvvatyA saha SaNkaraH । badDvA sUtramidaM SuBraM SivasyAtmA niveditaH ॥ DAraRIyamidaM tAvadyAvat prARasya DAraRam । tAsAntu tadvacaH SrutvA te kftvA mAnasaM taTA ॥ kftvA ca sammatiM tatra badDvA dorByAM suqorakam । tatastAH svagfhaM jagmuH saKIBiH parivAritAH ॥ kAlena mahatA tatra vismftaM tadvrataM nfpa ! । pramattayA candramuKyA vismftaYca suqorakam ॥ mftA kEScidahorAtrEH sA baBUva plavaNgamI । mAlA ca kukkuwI jAtA tvasamyagvratapAlanAt ॥ taTEva te ca mitriRyO jAte jAtismare kule । samBUya BUyastatrEva prAptaSca samayaH punaH ॥ taddine taddine prApte punaH kAle ca te mfte । adEvamAtfke deSe jAte gokulasaNkule ॥ rAjYo jAyA baBUvATa pfTvInATasya sA punaH । ISvarI nAma viKyAtA sA tu rAjYo'tivallaBA ॥ agnimIladvijasyAsIdBAryyA BUzaRanAmikA । purohitasya kAlena kukkuwI bahuputtriRI ॥ jAtismarA cAzwaputtrA taTEva cAmftaprajA । punarnirantarA prItirbaBUvATa tayordvija ॥ tatreSvarI puttramekaM prasUtA taYca rogiRam । navavarze tu paYcatvamagAttatra yuDizWira ! ॥ tatra tAM BUzaRA drazwumAjagAmAtiduHKitA । saKIBAvAdatisnehAdazwaputtrasamanvitA ॥ ayuktABaraRA nityaM svaBAvenEva BUzitA । tAM dfzwvA puttriRIM BavyAM prajajvAleSvarI ruzA ॥ tato gfhaM prezayitvA tAM saKIM tIvramatsarA । cintayAmAsa sA rAjYI tasyAH puttravaDaM prati ॥ hatA hatASca ye puttrAH punarjjIvantyanAmayAH । bahuputtrA jIvavatsA prayuktABaraRA kaTam । SoBase hyaDikaM Badre taqit sOdAminI yaTA ॥ BUzaRovAca । BAdre mAsi site pakze saptamyAM lalitAlaye । snAtvA SivaM leKayitvA maRqale ca sahAmbikam ॥ saMpUjya viDivat prAptaM trElokye yacca vidyate । tadeva hi vrataM pUrvvaM tvayA saha mayA kftam ॥ tanmayAcaritaM BaktyA tenAhaM susTirA saKi । tvayA nAcaritaM samyak dapEDmAtaSarIrayA ॥ tena te santatiSCinnA rAjye'pi sati duHKitA । praBAva eza kaTito bratasyAsya mayA saKi ! ॥ ardDaM tuByaM pradAsyAmi tasya Darmmasya suvrate । saKIBAvAt pratIcCa tvaM nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA ॥ saMpUjya SaNkaraM BaktyA kare badDvA suqorakam । yAvajjIvaM mayA tAvat SivasyAtmA niveditaH ॥ ityevaM samayaM kftvA tataH praBfti qorakam । svarRarUpyamayaM vApi karaSAKAsu DAraRam ॥ SaNkaraYcomayA sArdDaM sOvarRaM rAjatantaTA । tAmrapAtre pratizWApya brAhmaRAyopapAdayet ॥ pAyasaM pizwakaYcEva BakzyaM BojyaM prayatnataH । sagotrAn BojayitvA tu svayaM BuYjIta tatparam ॥ maRqalaM somasadfSaM SivasyAtmaniveditam । ityevaM pratijagrAha vratadAnaPalaM tataH ॥ baBUva suprajA sADvI ISvarI BuvaneSvarI । vratasyAsya praBAvena suputtrA tvaYca devaki ! ॥ Bavizyasi trilokeSaM puttraYca janayizyasi । ityevaM SrAvayitvA ca virarAma munistadA ॥ jagAma svapuraM pArTa mayApyevaM tavoditam । yAH striyaH svAcarizyanti vratametadyuDizWira ॥ kukvuwAKyaM plavaNgAKyaM devakyAcaritaM SuBam । tAsAM santativicCedo na kadAcidBavizyati ॥ striyaScEvAcarizyanti vratametat suKapradam । asmin loke suKaM BuktvA yAsyanti Sivamandiram ॥ yA kukkuwIvratamidaM plavagIsametaM devaM viBAvya hfdaye ca guruM niDAya । BaktyA karoti kaluzODaviGAtadakzaM sADvI sadA Bavati SoBanajIvavatsA ॥” iti BavizyapurARe kukkuwIvratakaTA samAptA ॥

a: ललित — a. [लल्-क्त] 1 Playing, sporting, dallying. --2 Amorous, sportive, wanton, voluptuous. --3 Lovely, beautiful, handsome, elegant, graceful; ललितललितैर्ज्योत्स्नाप्रायैरकृत्रिमविभ्रमैः (अंगकैः) U. 1. 20; विधाय सृष्टिं ललितां विधातुः R. 6. 37, 19. 39; 8. 1; Māl. 1. 15; Ku. 3. 75, 6. 45; Me. 32, 64. --4 Pleasing, charming, agreeable, fine; प्रियशिष्या ललिते कलाविधौ R. 8. 6; संदर्शितेव ललिताभिनयस्य शिक्षा M. 4. 9; V. 2. 18. --5 Desired. --6 Soft, gentle, Śi. 7. 64. --7 Tremulous, trembling. --तः N. of a musical scale. --तं 1 Sport, dalliance, play. --2 Amorous pastime, gracefulness of gait; any languid or amorous gesture in a woman; सुकुमारतयांगानां बिन्यासो ललितं भवेत् S. D.; Śi. 9. 79; Ki. 10. 52. --3 Beauty, grace, charm. --4 Any natural or artless act. --5 Simplicity, innocence. --Comp. --अभिनय a. consisting of graceful gesticulations or acting; V. 2. 18. --अर्थ a. having a pretty or amorous meaning; V. 2. 14. --पद a. {1} elegantly composed; Ś. 3. {2} consisting of amorous words. ˚बंधनं an amorous composition. --प्रहारः a soft or gentle blow. --ललित a. excessively beautiful; U. 1. 20. --लुलित a. unnerved yet charming; Māl. 1. 15.

k.v: कौतूहलं कौतुकं च कुतुकं च कुतूहलम्. स्त्रीणां विलासबिब्बोकविभ्रमा ललितं तथा॥

m: ललित—चैत्य m. N. of a Caitya, W.
